thread:
incident-bot: :bell: PagerDuty alert triggered: INC-49812 — Hosted inference 503 spike (policy: primary -> secondary -> manager). Service: hosted-inference-us-west-2. Threshold: 5xx > 10% over 3m. Paging primary @jordan_oncall now.

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to @jordan_oncall (call + push). Escalation timeout: 7m.

jordan_oncall: I got the push but no ring on phone, trying to ack via PD web.

incident-bot: 7m elapsed, no ack from primary. Escalating to secondary @sara_sre.

sara_sre: acking via mobile web — I clicked ack but I can't join the bridge, phone is on DND for a meeting. Trying to join via laptop.

pagerduty-bot: Secondary acknowledged incident INC-49812. (ack: sara_sre)

sara_sre: joining bridge now... audio failing for me, browser shows `Bridge join failed` — investigating network.

incident-bot: 12m since initial page, manager escalation fired to @ryan_manager (policy rule: manager after secondary unresponsive on bridge).

ryan_manager: joining bridge, taking command. Quick situation: SLOs show 503 burst from 16:28 -> 16:40, p50 latency fine but 5xx increased for tokenization-heavy models.

olivia_prod: customer dashboards: 503 rate ~15% for hosted-inference-us-west-2 across multiple routes. Top impacted customers: svc-a, mobile-chat. Error logs: `upstream read error` and `kv cache miss overload`.

mike_support: we have 3 priority-1 tickets opened by customers, status page draft queued.

jordan_oncall: FYI I never saw incoming call — carrier blocked for unknown reason, will check device.

sara_sre: looks like my ack didn't propagate to incident-bot correctly (PD shows ack, incident-bot still reported no bridge join). Could be webhook timeout.

ryan_manager: mitigation plan: 1) quick traffic reroute to dedicated-pool fallback, 2) scale inference-hosted deployment, 3) reduce batch size temporarily to lower memory pressure.

olivia_prod: confirming routing flag `route.hosted->fallback` ready in console under feature-flags/prod.

sara_sre: running scale now:```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-hosted --replicas=12
# verify pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-hosted -o wide
```

incident-bot: Automation executed: scaled inference-hosted replicas from 6 -> 12 (triggered by sara_sre).

ryan_manager: executing traffic flip to dedicated pool via admin API:```json
{
  "service": "hosted-inference",
  "route": "fallback-dedicated-pool",
  "force": true
}
```

olivia_prod: routing change in progress — DNS/edge done, LB draining old nodes.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-49812 acknowledged by ryan_manager (manager takeover).

mike_support: status page published: "Investigating increased 503 errors for hosted inference in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress." Ticket updates sent.

olivia_prod: error rate down to 3% after reroute and scale (16:50). Latency p95 stable. Looks like primary pool was saturated when batch sizes peaked.

jordan_oncall: I'm back onphone, tested PD call — seems carrier dropped earlier calls. Will escalate phone escalation settings in PD to include SMS fallback for manager policy.

sara_sre: root-cause hypothesis: sudden traffic pattern + a KV cache regression increased memory pressure; PD webhook timeout meant incident-bot didn't surface ack state correctly causing manager escalation to look like a missed-ack case.

ryan_manager: immediate next steps: 1) leave a short-term fix (routing/batch tweak) in place, 2) postmortem owner: sara_sre, 3) follow-up: add SMS fallback to manager escalation and increase secondary timeout to 8m, 4) add health-check for PD->incident-bot webhook latency.

mike_support: notifying affected customers with timeline + mitigation note.

olivia_prod: service errors normalized, closing mitigation window. Recommend no further traffic flips.

ryan_manager: marking incident as under control. Will wait 30m for stability then close PD incident. Owner: ryan_manager. Postmortem assigned to sara_sre.

incident-bot: PD incident INC-49812 set to "under control" by ryan_manager.

jordan_oncall: follow-up: I'll audit my rotation notification settings and carrier fallback.

sara_sre: will start postmortem draft and include PD webhook timeline + config change request.

ryan_manager: thanks team — nice quick ops. Proposed follow-ups: add SMS for manager fallback, add webhook latency alert, run a short oncall training about verifying bridge join vs ack. :thumbsup:

mike_support: closing notes: support notified customers; tickets updated.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-49812 will be auto-resolved after 1h of no regressions.

incident-bot: end of thread.
